info.name: BhuriBhoj API
info.description:
Live routes from routes/api.php (role-prefixed).

1. Import this collection + BhuriBhoj.local.postman_environment.json
2. Public → Auth → Login (token saved automatically)
3. Set collection var `door` to admin | president | manager | member for house routes

Removed (do not call): /subscriptions/purchase, /mess-invitations/*, /managers/*, /monthly-dues/*, /market-*, /guest-meals, /constant-expenses, /mess-rules, /fines, flat /auth/* without public|authorize prefix.

base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api  or  https://bhuribhoj-api.liwaas.com/api

request.description: Needs GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. New accounts may need mobile.
Public site identity + theme. Blank public_site_bengali / public_contact_email → null.
Needs public_contact_email in Admin → Configs. Throttle 8/min.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Visitor",
  "mess": "Sample Mess",
  "members": 12,
  "phone": "9800000000",
  "email": "visitor@example.com",
  "message": "Hello, we want to know more about BhuriBhoj."
}

item.name: Authorize
item.description: Any signed-in active user. Bearer token.

request.description: Returns user + seat (next: plans | mess_setup | dashboard | admin).
Admin can open a mess; optional president_user_id.
Blank public_contact_email or public_site_bengali hides them on the public site.

item.name: President
item.description: role:president. Buy plan then open mess, then house routes (mess.ready).

request.description: Creates Razorpay order or free coupon activation. Replaces old /subscriptions/purchase.
Payment status must be captured (not only authorized).
After active subscription with no mess yet (seat.next = mess_setup).

item.name: House ({{door}})
item.description: Uses collection var door = admin|president|manager|member. Only call routes that exist for that role (see API-FRONTEND.md).
